verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents the whole end-to-end flow. Agent Checkouts takes a product URL and a spending cap, runs the checkout on the user's behalf with any payment method the merchant accepts, and is polled until it reaches a terminal state. The delegated credential comes from agent cards: order intents with a fixed allowance, merchant lock and expiration, issued as one-time card numbers through Visa Intelligent Commerce or Mastercard Agent Pay so the agent never sees the real card. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, webhooks for agent-checkout status (v1 is poll-only), a staging environment for testing, explicit order-confirmation/receipt detail for agent checkouts, and broader card eligibility (Visa is limited to eligible US-issued cards).
